intro: Crafted from CRCA steel, this full-height storage keeps your essentials safe with adjustable shelves and a secure three-way locking system. Designed for demanding offices, the KD unit offers ample space and security.

features.title: Ample space with 4 full tiers
features.text: Keep everything in order with four spacious shelves, three sized for A4 box files and one for accessories, your all-in-one solution for tidy, functional storage.

features.title: Access made effortless
features.text: Say goodbye to jammed doors—steel hinged doors and recessed handles ensure smooth, easy access to everything you’ve stored.

features.title: Storage that adapts with you
features.text: Smart storage that shifts with you, height-adjustable shelves make room for both compact and oversized items.

features.title: Heavy-duty strength you can trust
features.text: Premium CRCA steel and rigid knock-down construction deliver unmatched durability. Each shelf supports up to 40 kg UDL for dependable heavy-duty storage.

features.title: Triple-lock safety built-in
features.text: Designed for security, the unit includes a cam lock with a three-way mechanism and shooting bolt, giving you confidence that items are always protected, providing maximum reliability in shared or high-traffic spaces.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
